title: Mirror
description: Working mirror blocks with live, real-time reflections. Rendered by the mod itself, no other rendering mods needed.
body:
# Mirror

Working mirror blocks for Minecraft. Place a mirror on a wall and it shows a real, live reflection of the world around it, you included. No other rendering mods needed.

## Features

- A wood-framed mirror that shows a live reflection, correct from any angle you look at it.
- You, other players and mobs, and the item in your hand all show up in the reflection.
- Place mirrors side by side and they join into one big mirror, with the frame opening up between them.
- Mirrors reflect other mirrors, so a mirror seen inside a reflection shows its own reflection.
- Proper occlusion: anything in front of a mirror, walls and your held item included, hides the reflection behind it.
- Reflections reach out to your render distance and fade into a soft fog you can adjust.

## Crafting

Sticks in the corners, glass on the sides, and an amethyst shard in the middle:

```
stick  glass  stick
glass  shard  glass
stick  glass  stick
```

Place it on a wall and look. The mirror faces the way you place it.

## Settings

Tune it from the in-game settings screen (through Mod Menu) or the config file: how many reflections show at once, how far they reach, whether mirrors reflect each other, and the fog. Changes apply right away. Reflections re-render the world, so if you want more frames, turn the reflection distance or count down.

## Requirements

- Fabric Loader and Fabric API
- Optional: Mod Menu and Cloth Config for the in-game settings screen (the mod works fine without them)
- In multiplayer, install it on the server and on every client

Available for Minecraft 26.1 and 26.2. Download the file that matches your version.
